Keeping Indiana Moving | Congressman Rudy Yakym Skip to main content Sign up for my Newsletter  Keeping Indiana Moving They don't call us the Crossroads of America for nothing. This is how Hoosier products get to market and how Hoosier families get where they're going. But too many of our roads and bridges are running on borrowed time, and too many good projects sit in a permitting queue for years while costs climb. I'm fighting for real infrastructure investment in Northern Indiana and tax dollars that actually get spent on the roads, bridges, and runways Hoosiers use every day.
